answer: Cross-Epoch Signature Continuity Rule: each identity signs a random beacon challenge every epoch, and the next epoch's signature must match the prior epoch's behavioral fingerprint (timing, key-use order, keystroke cadence). Mismatches freeze rewards until a falcon-style audit replays the full history. An attacker running N sybils must sustain N distinct consistent fingerprints across epochs, so each fake identity carries ongoing labor and audit exposure; a quill-recorded divergence forfeits that identity's accrued rewards.
